scope: Goodpjw public V8 15 native ANGLE KMBs, full 128 independent cut-wire GF2 basis, consecutive CCX gates separated ONLY by CX
source: original published V8 ANGLE KMB v2, all 15
interpretation: For the stated quadratic CX-only cut class, exact GF(2) output nonlinear dimensions are necessary AND lower bounds. All dimension-deficient cuts were checked for a spanning basis of polar rank-2 forms; none possessed a full such basis. This excludes only exact full-input 3->2 and 4->3 rewrites with as many quadratic product generators as output dimension in this fixed-window model. It does not prove an unrestricted nonlinear circuit lower bound, and does not cover 320/360 higher-degree windows, longer cuts, reachable-state-only optimizations, or altered cross-HMR schedules.
phase_scope: No phase operations inside tested cuts; output functions checked as formal arbitrary-input GF2 polynomials. No altered KMB produced.
